sceneJob: Make Karen's information-retrieval explanation feel alive without distracting from the narration or changing the approved adult-graphic-novel frame.

states.job: Establish the existing CRT pattern without movement.
Change only a few existing green blocks with a soft, gradual luminance transition.
Let the screen state read; no additional motion.
A second small, different block group changes slowly.
Return every overlaid block to the exact source state for a seamless wrap.

lockedStillPixels: Karen and her identity, anatomy, clothing and pose
room, lamp, books, papers, computer body and keyboard
window, building, rain and exterior lights
forbidden: camera movement, zoom, pan or crop drift
new text, generated lettering or new screen objects
regeneration of any source pixel outside the CRT display face
Python, CSS, HTML, SVG or JavaScript visible-pixel authoring
acceptance: At 1x the screen is visibly alive but never competes with the narration.
No change begins or completes in less than 1.5 seconds.
The first and last decoded frames are visually identical within encode tolerance.
Motion is confined to existing green CRT blocks; every locked still pixel remains unchanged.
A known-static control is rejected by the calibrated motion gate before the candidate is trusted.
